description:
C3 2023 SUMMER SUBMISSION

A very unusual background from the obscure game Youkai Buster: Ruka no Daibouken. It is a great fit for unusual level themes. It is a very big background so I had to use the extended horizontal level feature from Lunar Magic.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
